'''Watchroo''' is a [[Rock]] type [[DPS]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Gopher]] at 6 bronze stars, and evolves into [[Bastogard]] at 18 stars after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "After taking down quite a few [[Zobos]], Watchroo has grown much bolder and even dares to provoke them. Watching Zobos scramble through the dunes, only to lose track of a darting Watchroo? Never gets old."

Watchroo is a gold rarity Tatari.

==Appearance==
A small rodent which is usually underground, with just its head poking out from its burrow. On top of its head is a pile of sand/dirt with a small red flag, resembling a sandcastle. It has grey-brown fur, an off-white snout, and a pink nose and feet.

Watchroo's [[Tatari#Glitter Tataris|Glitter]] form changes the color of its fur to dark blue, and its feet become light peach in color. Additionally, the flag on its head becomes purple.

== Evolution Trial ==
Watchroo's evolution trial unlocks once it reaches 18 stars. To evolve it into [[Bastogard]] you need to complete the following two tasks:

* Feed Watchroo to increase stats 3 times.
* In [[Island Gold Rush]] use 5,000 energy drinks.

== Trivia ==
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "After endless Zobo fights, Watchroo finally snagged a tiny outpost to live in. Rent & deposit: 5,000 Candies."
* Prior to the update on 5/12/2026, its bio description said: "Watchroo makes whacking easier by using a red flag to mark the position of the head. However, while tunneling underground, Watchroo moves at remarkable speed and is rarely hit."
